labeling_rule: A chunk is relevant when a clinician asking this query would accept its verbatim text as a direct answer or as the guideline context for the finding. Labels were written by reading corpus/guidelines/corpus.json before any retrieval change was measured. A1C_INTERPRETATION is the same five-chunk set the W2 gate accepts for an abnormal A1C (w2RegressionGate.js A1C_INTERPRETATION_SOURCES).
